name: Mark SDH Subtitles
focusedTests: isolated x86_64 and universal exclusive-mode application
acceptance: Patched NuvioTV shows Settings > Morphe > Subtitles > Mark SDH subtitles as a native switch
The switch defaults off and persists after force-stop and reboot
Tracks in any language with explicit SDH, HI, HOH, CC, hearing-impaired, or closed-caption evidence display SDH once
Addon tracks with explicit metadata display SDH immediately
English addon files with repeated annotation evidence display SDH after bounded background sampling
English local file sources with repeated annotation evidence display SDH after bounded background sampling
At least 20 bracketed parentheses or square-bracket annotation blocks are required for content detection
Music-note lyrics and speaker labels without bracketed annotations do not mark a subtitle as SDH
Non-English tracks are not content-sampled unless they carry an explicit SDH marker
Playback startup and initial addon repository completion do not wait for content detection
No crash, ANR, VerifyError, or fatal log during launch, settings, playback, or subtitle selection
